newsitem.title: USA: Champion files $600 mln debt shelf.
newsitem.headline: Champion files $600 mln debt shelf.

text.p: Champion International Corp said Friday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $600 million in debt securities.
Of the totol amount, $200 million in debt securities had been previously available for sale by the company, the filing said.

Net proceeds will be added to the company's general corporate funds and may be used to pay at maturity a portion of the company's commercial paper and short-term notes which are classified as long-term debt for balance sheet purposes.
Proceeds may also be used to reduce or refinance long-term debt or for general corporate purposes, the filing said.
Champion International Corp, based in Stamford, Conn., is a domestic manufacturer of paper for business communications, commercial printing, publications and newspapers.
